sing.speaker: choir
sing.text: You. The one with the Beacon. We drowned for a very long time and we have been practising your name. Come down. We are invited, and so are you.

choices.text: Kaj-7, is this what you hear?

who.speaker: choir
who.text: Your makers. They chose the flood over us. They were wrong, and the flood agreed with them. Ask the one who sealed the vaults. Ask the shield who burned the stair. Everyone here was chosen.

kaj.speaker: kaj7
kaj.text: Yes. But it is not calling me now. It is calling you. I would like us to go up.
